name: Jacques le Vert
description: A warrior who abandoned his sword to return to Pendelhaven and protect its creatures.

timeline.summary: Jacques le Vert abandons his sword and returns to Pendelhaven to protect its creatures.
timeline.quote: Abandoning his sword to return to the lush forest of Pendelhaven, Jacques le Vert devoted his life to protecting the creatures of his homeland.
